question: Which aspects of ritual abiding, universal action-mindedness, and excellence are honored in the deity?
premises: The deity is addressed as abiding in ritual action.
The deity is addressed as minded toward all actions.
The deity is addressed as excellent.
inference: The deity is honored as present in ritual, engaged in all actions, and supreme.
plain_english: Obeisance to the one abiding in ritual action; obeisance to the one minded toward all actions; obeisance to the excellent one.
